_comment: Windows CI test-suite baseline. Consumed by the 'Fail if a suite ran nothing or lost tests' step.
actual < expected -> red   (cases were deleted or silently skipped)
actual > expected -> green (new cases are not a failure) with a 'please update' warning
Why not just raise a hard-coded floor: that only moves the same rot to the next person.
A committed baseline shows up in review as a diff and can be git-blamed.
Update: run windows-ci once, read the 'MediaHub.Tests: total=N' line, write N into expected.
ASCII only on purpose: PowerShell 5.1 Get-Content decodes BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI and corrupts
non-ASCII text, which breaks ConvertFrom-Json. Keep this file pure ASCII.
